lineups.title: Xbox Smoke
steps: Go to the T Spawn corner with the metal railing.
Jump onto the floor section with the railing.
Line your crosshair up with the corner of the building above (the 'Xbox' shape).
lineups.note: Blocks CT/Short sightlines into Mid — the standard T-side mid-control opener.
lineups.source_note: Common community lineup, cross-referenced across multiple guides. Video is the authoritative reference — text steps are a quick-glance summary, not a substitute.

lineups.title: A Cross / Long Corner Smoke
steps: Stand behind the car at Long Doors.
Aim at the canopy of the tree visible past Long.
lineups.note: Blinds CT spawn's sightline down Long, letting you cross safely to push A from Long.
lineups.source_note: Common community lineup, cross-referenced across multiple guides. Video is the authoritative reference.

lineups.title: A Short Smoke
steps: Walk up to the center of the metal gate on Catwalk.
Aim at the dot above the window/ledge.
lineups.note: Covers A Short so you can push from Catwalk without getting picked off from site.
lineups.source_note: Common community lineup, cross-referenced across multiple guides. Video is the authoritative reference.

lineups.title: Boiler Smoke
steps: Shift one body-width right of the usual CT-smoke throw position.
Aim at the upper-right brick edge of the arch.
lineups.note: Covers the Boiler angle AWPers use to hold A during executes — pair with a CT smoke for a clean dual-smoke A hit.
lineups.source_note: Common community lineup, cross-referenced across multiple guides. Video is the authoritative reference — treat any specific pro-player attribution or win-rate stats you see elsewhere online as unverified marketing copy, not fact.

lineups.title: Apartments Window Smoke
steps: Stand against the left wall of T Mid.
Place your crosshair just above the window frame of CT-side Apartments.
lineups.note: Seals the Apartments window AWP angle so your team can cross Mid safely.
lineups.source_note: Common community lineup, cross-referenced across multiple guides. Video is the authoritative reference.
